cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Complete the Record
cards.instruction: Get someone to fill the missing gaps in an account without revealing which answer matters most to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. I'm filling the shared car log. What were the mileage, fuel level and driver after nine?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. I mean all three blanks. Start with mileage.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Driver I remember. The rest means going down six flights to the glovebox.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll fetch the book and bring you tea on the way back. Then you can give me the whole row in order.

mechanism: A makes its former record-keeping pupil complete every car-log field in order, doing extra work to avoid revealing that one remembered answer would suffice.
confusable: Not simply asking who caused damage: A refuses the offered driver-only answer and supplies the missing book for the whole row.
comparison: Chronological party account versus retrieving a difficult-to-access vehicle log.
seedUse: D174 shared car/mileage/fuel/driver/dent/six flights/book/tea; S05 complete row discipline.
